app.title: FreeCORE TrueNAS Core – Continued
app.author: sashk
app.description: An open‑source NAS operating system based on FreeBSD, providing enterprise‑grade storage, snapshotting, and replication features.
proposed_tests: Build the TrueNAS Core ISO from source and verify that the installer boots on a virtual machine
Create a storage pool with ZFS, add 10GB of synthetic data, and measure write/read throughput
Configure snapshot and rollback features, ensuring data integrity after deletion
Test the web GUI login flow and API authentication by sending a curl request with session cookie
